import re
import sys

def scan(text, pattern, acc, count):
    for m in pattern.finditer(text):
        if count:
            acc += 1
        else:
            l = len(m.group())
            if l > acc:
                acc = l
    return acc

def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    # first line ignored
    st = lines[1] if len(lines) >= 2 else ''
    pattern = re.compile(r'[^_]+')
    maxl = 0
    cnt = 0
    i = 0
    j = 0
    last_close = st.rfind(')')
    while i < last_close:
        open_idx = st.find('(', i)
        maxl = scan(st[j:open_idx], pattern, maxl, False)
        next_close = st.find(')', j + 1)
        j = next_close + 1
        close_idx = st.find(')', i + 1)
        cnt += scan(st[open_idx + 1:close_idx], pattern, 0, True)
        i = close_idx
    maxl = scan(st[j:], pattern, maxl, False)
    print(f"{maxl} {cnt}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
